name: Easy Sheet Pan Shawarma-Spiced Chicken Drumsticks with Butternut Squash & Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Cut spice mix packages open along the line for the "sauce mix." Place mix in a small bowl, add yogurt, and whisk to combine the sauce. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (1.37 oz) envelope Shawarma spice mix
2 cups plain Greek yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Cut the spice mix packages open along the second line and place "seasoning mix" in a large bowl. Add oil and salt, then whisk to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and trim green beans. Add to the bowl with the spice paste along with butternut squash.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb green beans
2 (10 oz) pkg frozen butternut squash, pieces

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Add to the bowl, then toss to combine and coat everything in the spice paste. Divide chicken and veggies between two large baking sheet pans, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheets in the preheated oven and roast, stirring halfway, until veggies are golden and chicken is cooked through, 40-45 minutes.
When the chicken and veggies are done, toast pita bread if desired, then cut in half.
To serve, divide chicken, veggies, pita, and yogurt sauce between plates. Enjoy!
